# Command reference

JSON mode writes one stable envelope to stdout and is the default when stdout is not a TTY. Text, raw, and help output are explicitly selected exceptions. Network commands require an explicit `--profile`; there is no active or default profile. See `contract.md` for exit codes and envelopes.

## Global flags

| Flag | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` | bool | preview a supported local change without applying it |
| `--fields` | stringSlice | comma-separated fields to request and emit |
| `-o, --output` | string | output format: text, json, or raw |
| `--profile` | string | named Jira profile (required for every network command) |
| `--timeout` | duration | abort the command after this duration |
| `-v, --verbose` | bool | write redacted request activity to stderr |
| `--yes` | bool | confirm a local overwrite or destructive action |

## Commands

### `jira-cli auth list`

List non-secret profile metadata without reading Keychain

No flags of its own.

### `jira-cli auth login`

Validate and store one profile token in macOS Keychain

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--email` | string |  | Atlassian account email |
| `--expires-at` | string |  | optional token expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `--site` | string |  | Jira Cloud site, exactly https://<tenant>.atlassian.net |
| `--token-kind` | string | `classic` | API token kind: classic or scoped |
| `--token-stdin` | bool |  | read one bounded token from stdin without echo |

### `jira-cli auth logout`

Delete one exact profile credential and its metadata

No flags of its own.

### `jira-cli auth status`

Show one profile and optionally validate its stored credential

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--check` | bool |  | read the exact Keychain entry and call Jira /myself |

### `jira-cli comments list`

Read one comment page

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--cursor` | string |  | opaque cursor from meta.next_cursor |
| `--issue` | string |  | exact Jira issue key or ID |
| `--limit` | int | `50` | maximum comments in this page (1-100) |

### `jira-cli contract`

Print the versioned envelope and exit-code contract

No flags of its own.

### `jira-cli issues get`

No flags of its own.

### `jira-cli skills install`

install the Jira Agent Skill for Codex and/or Claude Code

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dest` | string |  | explicit skills root for one provider |
| `--project-dir` | string | `.` | project directory for project scope |
| `--provider` | string |  | target provider: codex, claude, or all |
| `--scope` | string | `user` | install scope: user or project |
